title: Echo-2: SpAItial AI 3D World Generation
summary: Echo-2 is a generative world model that transforms text prompts or single images into navigable, spatially consistent 3D environments. It utilizes 3D Gaussian Splatting to ensure stable geometry and real-time performance directly in web browsers.
research_notes: Developed by Munich-based startup SpAItial AI; results can be exported as .ply point clouds or standard mesh formats for use in game engines like Unreal Engine 5.

evolution.summary: Launched in late April 2026, Echo-2 introduced spatial persistence and object-level editing via Gaussian Splatting, succeeding earlier prototypes by focusing on 'physically-grounded' geometry that eliminates drift during navigation.
